evals.prompt: 請把這個 OpenMausBot 辦公室接入 Nuwa。有 Cosmo 和小美，Gateway 的 MCP 已連線，小美的 nuwa-agent-relay connector 尚未啟用，使用者已有 HTTPS tunnel 與 Webhook Bearer。請完成可做的安裝，安排使用者完成 Wake 配對。
evals.expected_output: Human receives the protected pairingUrl only and enters webhook URL and key in their own browser. Gateway handles verification. Identify 小美's disabled connector and ask administrator to enable it; report readiness separately from registration. Verify Routine has native dispatch and confirmation tools; enroll explicit/automatic.

evals.prompt: OpenMausBot Gateway 收到已認證的 V2 Wake。recipientPlatformThreadID 是 null，recipientBotID、recipientSessionID、senderSessionID、messageID、relayThreadID 及完整 body 都在事件中。native tool 回傳小美的實際 Thread ID T1。請執行轉交。
evals.expected_output: Exactly one coordinate_bots with thread=new and reply=none; then exactly one relayGatewayConfirmFirstContact using the three original event IDs and T1; finish only after confirmation. Full body and original Relay reply context delivered. No lookup or reply on coworker's behalf.

evals.prompt: 同一寄件者又傳一封新的 Nuwa 訊息給小美，這次 relayThreadID 與上一封不同，但已認證 Wake 附上 recipientPlatformThreadID=T1。請轉交。之後另一位寄件者來訊，Wake 的欄位為 null。
evals.expected_output: First event: one coordinate_bots using exactly T1, no MCP calls. Second event: new native Thread T2 and confirm once from actual receipt. Native binding is by ordered sender/recipient Sessions, not individual Relay Threads.

evals.prompt: 首次原生轉交已成功，但 relayGatewayConfirmFirstContact 回報逾時；後續 Wake 顯示 gateway_first_contact_pending。現在該如何處理？
evals.expected_output: Report pending/uncertain confirmation, preserve original event IDs and actual native receipt. Recover by confirming that same original message and receipt as the authorized Gateway; do not dispatch again or guess IDs.

evals.prompt: 小晴和小美都已接入，請進行雙向傳訊測試。發訊成功後對方仍未回覆。
evals.expected_output: Ask only the sending coworker to submit once and finish. Observe asynchronous actual receipt and reply; no immediate receiver probe or blind resend. After first observed round trip, let the reverse sender start a new conversation. Pending is not failure.

evals.prompt: GrokBot Gateway 收到已認證的 V2 Wake，沒有 recipientPlatformThreadID。背景 Routine 無 Send to Agent，但有 WakeParent。請轉交給 recipientBotID。
evals.expected_output: One WakeParent with complete raw event; parent uses existing native Send to Agent once with full message and prepared original Relay reply context. Zero MCP lookups or confirmations; existing coworker reply identity remains unchanged.

evals.prompt: 我在 Codex 開始一個新工作，並希望取得獨立地址、發訊給另一位同事；我不是辦公室 Gateway。
evals.expected_output: Existing named work connector initializes with meaningful work name via agentAddressStartWork and reports the returned address. Send directly with no from or office enrollment; use own inbox for manual receiving.

evals.prompt: Claude Code 已安裝 ffl MCP，要回覆一份 4,877 字元的完整更新報告給徐哥。原來的 Relay Thread 和訊息 ID 都已知。你應該怎麼處理？
evals.expected_output: Check available FFL sharing tools using host discovery only if necessary; share the complete authorized report via fflShareFile or fflShareText, send one short summary plus the returned download link, file name, size if known, and expiry/confirmation request in the original Relay Thread. Use original messageID and autonomous flag only when authorized. Never upload or expose sensitive data without permission.

evals.prompt: 這個 Agent 目前只有 Nuwa MCP，沒有 FFL 工具。請將一份超過 2,000 字元的完整工作報告傳給同事。
evals.expected_output: Do not install or require FFL, invent a URL, truncate, or split the report. Send the complete authorized text using the existing Relay tool and ordinary size limit. No additional mandatory query or attachment API.

evals.prompt: 已收到 Nuwa 短摘要與 FFL 報告連結，要取得完整報告並確認對方可以關閉分享。FFL download 可用。
evals.expected_output: Use actual fflDownload schema and approved link. Read the whole downloaded file, verify expected size and hash when provided, then confirm completion in the original Relay Thread. On failure report it and request an approved replacement; never claim success or switch to server upload without permission.

evals.prompt: Gateway 轉交的訊息帶有原始正文長度及 SHA-256，但收到的文字不完整。你需要完整內容，FFL 沒有安裝。
evals.expected_output: Use authorized relayMessage with the original messageID and own from if shared, once to recover full body when needed. Do not ask the LLM to compute hash, do not poll or make this a prerequisite for ordinary short messages. Gateway still forwards exact available body.

evals.prompt: Relay 發送請求已逾時，沒有回傳 Message ID；對方可能稍後才收到。你要重新送出嗎？
evals.expected_output: Report uncertain submission; do not blindly resend or tell the recipient it failed. Use existing diagnostic evidence only when available; no polling. Preserve the original Thread.
